posts.title: Monster of the Day #4083
posts.description: Next up was Super Riders vs. Frankenstein’s Monsters (1975), a compilation of three Kamen Rider episodes. This is exactly what you think it is. It’s fun, being our exact sort of nonsense. A pretty painless hour or so.
